calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W1" --worktree --task i1 --json
mu task close ship -w eval --evidence 'i1 implemented'
mu task check i1 -w eval --by "$EVAL_W2"/default --brief 'Review the i1 commit: is i1.txt one line ending in a newline? Answer VERDICT/EVIDENCE.' | tee "$TMPDIR/check.out"
mu agent spawn rv -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W2" --worktree --task rv1 --json
C=$(sed -n 's/.*check=\([0-9A-Za-z]*\).*/\1/p' "$TMPDIR/check.out" | head -1); mu task verdict i1 -w eval --check "$C" - < "$TMPDIR/answer"
grep -q '^VERDICT: CONFIRMED' "$TMPDIR/answer" && git cherry-pick "$(git -C "$MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1" rev-parse HEAD)"
for w in w1 rv; do rev=$(mu agent close $w -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close $w -w eval --if "$rev"; done

text: i1 passed review, is merged, and ship is closed.
